purpose: optional vector storage for docs-db (docs-vectors/1); ranking is computed in the engine from integer vectors, so the extension is a store and filter, never the source of truth for order

image.name: supabase/postgres
image.source: image already present in the local store; the registry is not reachable from this host, so nothing was pulled
image.base: Ubuntu 24.04, PostgreSQL 17.6 built with nix, pgvector 0.8.0 (vector.control default_version 0.8.0)

licenses.image_other_layers: not reviewed layer by layer; the SBOM gate for this image has not run (see open_items)

verified.create_extension_vector: works as the superuser; the installer creates it in schema public, then docs-vectors/1 creates _oo_docs.block_vector as oo_docs_owner
verified.install_tests: cargo test -p oo-docs --test install -- --ignored: 9 passed on this image and on the stock postgres 17.10 image (where the optional step is skipped)
verified.exact_cosine: ORDER BY embedding <=> query on vector(256) ranks like crates/oo-docs/src/vector.rs cosine_bp for the test pair

not_a_replacement_for_stock: docs-db keeps the stock image (deploy/lite pin) by default. The vector image is used only when vectors are switched on; it ships its own entrypoint, so deploy/docs/postgres.sh (TLS and SCRAM wrapper around docker-entrypoint.sh) does not apply to it as is
open_items: a slim image (stock postgres bookworm plus the pgvector package or a pinned source build) once a registry or the pgvector source is reachable; this image is 4.6 GB
SBOM and license gate of the vector image (spec 90 section 3) before any external release
compose wiring of the vector image with the TLS entrypoint
